releases.title: DeskBar AI v2.6.6: AI voice honours the configured endpoint
releases.changelog:
• AI voice [MIC] upload now uses the configured ai_url (/secrets.ini, Settings) instead of the compile-time host
• Default AI endpoint moved to autobots.my.to (was the parked placeholder api.your-domain.com)
• Non-JSON HTTP 200 replies report 'Server sent a web page, not an AI reply' instead of 'Bad server response'
• Upload errors log the resolved host and path

releases.title: DeskBar AI v2.6.7: OTA catalog points at the real repo slug
releases.changelog:
• OTA catalog / binary URLs now use rahulraj80/DeskBar-AI instead of the pre-rename rahulraj80/TuneBar slug
• The OTA screen and /api/ota/repos no longer rely on GitHub's rename redirect
• Release links (repo, releases page, firmware download) updated in the same pass
